title: Phase 1: Protected and Honest Baseline
description: Authenticated callers only, no forged-telemetry path, non-finite and partial-push evidence handled honestly, deprecated graph intent path retired. Requirements ACC-01..05, EVID-01..02, OPS-01..02, INTENT-01. Plans: .planning/phases/01-protected-and-honest-baseline/01-01..01-09-PLAN.md (9 plans, 7 waves). Related: contextbroker-2p9 (stays open; authority scope is Phase 3).

title: Bitemporal fluents for bindings and topology links
description: Nothing in Fuseki records when a binding or topology link was valid or known; only :pinnedBound keeps a single value. Add fluent state with valid time and knowledge time (spec section 5, risk 2: current state overwrites historically material fluent state). Gap analysis section 4 item 1.

title: Context request/response contract: purpose, scope, authority, eligibility, expiry
description: Add purpose, scope, authority and context classes to the request; add an eligibility result and explicit expiry/freshness boundary to the response (spec sections 6 and 7). Open decision: JSON-LD, NGSI-LD or the current purpose-built envelope. Gap analysis section 4 item 2.

title: Authentication and authority scope for the REST API
description: The REST API is unauthenticated, which conflicts with the access and authority scope in the request contract. Gap analysis section 4 item 6. Related to the request/response contract issue.

title: Event store: finish state_reconciliation and syslog parser
description: Events (spec section 3) need a real store with semantic references. state_reconciliation and ingestion/syslog_parser.py are stubs. Gap analysis section 4 item 4.

title: Durable situation state (E02)
description: IntentStore, decision_records and loop_coordination/reservations.py are in-memory, so continuity is lost on restart. Needs a durable or graph-shaped record with an expiry policy. Gap analysis section 4 item 3.

title: ABox directory: load only files written by bind_intent
description: The ABox is generated per intent, so a static allow-list does not fit; a licensed .ttl copied into ontologies/abox/ would still load via ingestion.load_ontologies. Restrict to files written by bind_intent. Follow-up from phase 1 plan 02 task 3 (T-01-09, accepted). Plan: .planning/phases/01-protected-and-honest-baseline/01-02-PLAN.md

title: OKF knowledge and lexical/vector retrieval
description: Portable curated knowledge (OKF) and lexical/vector retrieval (spec 4.4, 4.5) are not built. Largest new components, least urgent while the demo is an intent-assurance loop. Gap analysis section 4 item 5.
